The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 52c828f91521d93c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Over U, Riemann–Hilbert identifies Y1,u with the total space over S of this flat bundle at parameter t(u). These identifications are homeomorphisms of families. At u = 0 they identify the scalar correspondence of Figure 1 at λ = 1 with the flat Betti scalar correspondence, compatibly with its pullbacks and Gysin maps.
